en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Доне' is probably a pet name or vocative next to Донке, unsure. 'Дај дуни, дуни, дуни' is my reading (dunuti = blow); it may be a refrain filler. 'Ал' as 'red' is my reading.

words_to_learn.en: I fell for, began to love
